# Don't Go Missing

> Don't Go Missing is an iPhone safety app for hikers, hunters, anglers and anyone heading out of cell coverage. You build a trip plan in about 90 seconds, text it to people you trust, and the app reminds you to check in and alarms on your phone when you are overdue. Everything runs on the device with no account.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone (iOS 16 or later). App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dont-go-missing/id6768712827
- Price: subscription, $4.99 per week or $49.99 per year in the United States, billed by Apple.
- Works with no signal: check-in reminders, return-time and overdue alarms, and the GPS trail. These are stored and scheduled on the phone.
- Needs signal: sending any text message, including the trip plan, a running-late message and an SOS.
- It does not alert contacts automatically. Contacts receive the plan before the trip, with a deadline for calling for help.
- It is not an emergency service and not a replacement for a satellite messenger or personal locator beacon.
- Privacy: no account, no ads, no cloud sync. Trips, contacts and the GPS trail stay on the device.

## Product

- [Home](https://dontgomissing.com/): what the app does, how it works, what works offline, comparison with other safety options, pricing and FAQ.

## Free tools

- [Hiking Trip Plan Generator](https://dontgomissing.com/tools/trip-plan/): builds a trip plan to text, email or print. Runs in the browser, nothing is uploaded.
- [Hiking Time and Turnaround Calculator](https://dontgomissing.com/tools/hiking-time-calculator/): estimates hiking time with Naismith's rule and works out a turnaround time.

## Guides

- [How to Leave a Hiking Trip Plan](https://dontgomissing.com/guides/hiking-trip-plan/): what to include, who to give it to, when they should call for help, and a template.
